description: The only way to give this round's answer. Fill the fields and call it; the platform builds and stores the answer from them. Do not write the answer as text.

parameters.body: Your answer in the person's language; not empty.
parameters.ideas: [] or 2-3 {title, detail} options for a real choice.
parameters.ideas[].title: One line, at most 120 chars.
parameters.goalCardDrafts: No goal and new work only: at least one draft, else [].
parameters.goalCardDrafts[].screening: Optional; null when unscreened, else all seven fields.
parameters.goalCardDrafts[].screening.conflictsWith: Bare goalIds; platform fills projectId and aggregateType.
parameters.goalCardDrafts[].screening.dependsOn: Bare goalIds; platform fills projectId and aggregateType.
